The file is the negative corpus of the Rust frontend's types (#467): a real Rust fragment with trait
implementations, `&dyn Any`, `impl FnOnce` parameters and names its generator fills in later, which
the frontend must refuse with a diagnostic and without a crash. It is kept byte for byte as the commit
has it - do not reformat it, and replace it only as a whole with the file of a newer commit, updating
commit and hash here.
